exposure: method and length of learning FABM rules
previous use of other cycle observation or conception control methods
reasons for giving up previous methods
outcome: level of satisfaction with the selected FABM
level of confidence with the selected FABM
cohort: The study included 372 women of childbearing age who reported using fertility recognition methods.
finding: The sympto-thermal method is the most commonly used FABM, with respondents using the Creighton Model reporting the highest level of satisfaction and confidence.
